recordedBy: Lead (independent correction of WW-018/#310 holdout protocol)
status: Prospective revision-3 freeze; holdout-3 NOT RUN until this entire record, runner and pinned trees are committed. Revision-2 objective rows are valid but its frozen protocol remains INCOMPLETE (missing contemporaneous CPU). Original holdout remains historical evidence. Listening BLOCKED.
reason: The revision-2 once-only run did not capture its required CPU measurement. The test tree now selects a fresh disjoint holdout-3 split, and this revision prospectively pins a 0.25-second per-PID CPU telemetry protocol. Renderer source, two-case scheduler, generator, truth, objective gates, recipe and all case counts are unchanged.
pinnedTreesRule: Paths are relative to Packages/WaveWranglerKit; RenderFreezeTests checks working-tree Git IDs against these pins. The renderer source is identical to revisions 1 and 2. Revision-1 and revision-2 records/pins are historical and are not changed. Any subsequent tree change requires a new dated freeze and new disjoint holdout.
scheduler: Unchanged revision-2 test-only task group: at most two synthetic cases in flight, with one new case admitted for each completion. One Swift Testing test at a time; --jobs 4 limits compilation. Full 16/48 seeded cases plus one fixed multi-span regression case per split; canonical record order retained.
seedDerivation: First 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256("ww-m2-fixture|v1|M2-RENDER-001|<split>|<index>"). Original calibration uses "calibration", original holdout "holdout", revision 2 "holdout-2", revision 3 exclusively "holdout-3" for indices 0..47. All 160 seeded identities are unique and pairwise disjoint, checked by RenderFreezeTests. The fixed multi-span regression case is shared across splits and is not held out.

generator.case: One group, one 6-channel occurrence on one affine epoch; stratum = index mod 8.
generator.tones: Channel c: amplitude 0.5 at fraction r_c * (1 - 0.02 u) of lower Nyquist; r=[0.02,0.15,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.8], seeded phase.
generator.stopband: When 0.98 * (Fin/(a Fout)) > 1.01, six tones between output Nyquist and 0.98 input Nyquist (normalised).
generator.landmarks: 0.9-amplitude seeded-sign impulse at N/8 on every channel, and at N/4 + c*N/12 on channel c only.
generator.inactive: Channel index mod 6 carries -1 dBFS seeded uniform noise; all other channels exact zero.
generator.multiSpan: One unchanged fixed MixedGroup case per split (kink, gap, unsupported epoch, 44.1/48 kHz occurrences), with 12 landmarks and two skew pairs. The same multi-span case appears in all splits as disclosed regression coverage; it is not held out.

truth: The generator's WWTimeMap forward (alignedTime) and inverse (sourceFrame), not the render plan. Tone truth uses the exact inverse at hull ends and linear interpolation within an affine segment.
measurement: Unchanged from m2-freeze-render: steady frames with every tap in span; least-squares gain/phase/residual vs exact tone, parabolic landmark peak within four frames of truth with sign, common-impulse and phase-derived skew, inactive peak in dBFS. NaN or missing evidence fails. Canonical records sort by (caseIndex, kind, channel, encoded JSON).

holdout.enable: Only via bash scripts/render-holdout-3.sh <new outside-repo evidence directory> on a clean freeze-containing commit; WW_M2_RENDER_3_HOLDOUT=1 swift test --jobs 4 --no-parallel --filter holdoutSplitMeetsEveryFrozenGate

renderer.recipe: m2Candidate: Kaiser-windowed sinc, halfWidth 32 taps per side, passband edge 0.8, stopband edge 1.0, beta 9.6, 2048 table phases, chunk 4096 output frames, maximum decimation 64

cpuTelemetry.sampler: macOS ps -A -o pid=,ppid=,pgid=,%cpu=,comm= at 0.25-second intervals; record epoch timestamp, PID, PPID, process-group ID, %CPU and command for every descendant by PPID ancestry of the isolated swift-test PID, from launch through process exit. SwiftPM testing helpers start their own process groups, so PGID-only filtering is invalid. Require at least one SwiftPM testing-helper observation, first/last samples within 1 second of start/end, no >1-second gaps, no failed ps calls, and every observed PID at <=400%. Missing telemetry is INCOMPLETE; test/gate or CPU failure is FAIL, never rerun.

familyPeakEvidence: Reuse 38.5 MiB ru_maxrss and 198632-byte renderer working set from docs/m2/evidence/ww-018/holdout-timing.txt (original frozen source tree 94604633d6464391ade116b363f8874675381bf5); do not present as a new revision-3 timing measurement.
holdoutProtocol: On a clean commit containing this complete prospective freeze, pinned test and source trees and runner, with one-minute load <=24 and no concurrent heavy holdout, run each fresh holdout-3 case exactly once through the pinned CPU-telemetry runner. Publish the raw 48-case-plus-fixed-regression records, per-gate counts/maxima and nearest-rank p95, host/start load, exit/runtime, complete per-PID CPU samples and peak against <=400%; retain any failure or incomplete telemetry without rerun. Revision-1 and revision-2 pins and original records stay untouched. Listening remains BLOCKED; the full final-head script gate belongs to M3 coordination.
